props.title: Welcome to New Life.
props.body: The Welcome Path is the plainest answer to what this church is — our values and culture, the vision, the mission, our story, and how a person becomes part of this community. It is five lessons in the New Life app, and it is where the road to membership starts.

props.title: What membership means here.
props.body: Moving from attending to belonging — what we ask of members, what you can ask of us, and how to take the step. Staff can fill this in directly in the Page Builder.
